correctness.rationale: Under the stated two-sided convention the transfer amplitudes from independent white-noise coordinates can be normalized to [(b+iω)+tρ, t sqrt(1-ρ²)] divided by (a+iω)(b+iω), with a common sqrt(2D_x). The squared norm gives the displayed PSD with c>0. For z=ω² the derivative has numerator a²b²-c(a²+b²)-2cz-z², strictly decreasing on z>=0. Its unique positive root when c<h gives the stated peaks (two strict local maxima attaining the same global value). Otherwise it is negative for z>0; at equality the leading drop in ω is -2D_x c ω^4/(a^4 b^4). The peak criterion is t²+2bρt+b^4/(a²+b²)<0: this requires negative ρ and its minimum over positive t is negative exactly at the claimed strict ρ gate. The limiting threshold uses t=b²/sqrt(a²+b²), not a peak at equality. For an independent covariance check, the stationary moment equations give Var(Y)=D_y/b, (a+b) Cov(X,Y)=kD_y/b+2ρsqrt(D_xD_y), and a Var(X)=D_x+k Cov(X,Y). For τ>=0, C_x'+a C_x=k Cov(X,Y) exp(-bτ). Solving gives the two-exponential expression when a differs from b and the affine-times-exponential expression at a=b. In a peaked case c<h<min(a²,b²), so the slower term is negative and the faster one positive, with positive sum at zero and strictly decreasing positive-to-negative-magnitude ratio; for a=b the affine bracket has strictly negative slope. This proves one sign change and also checks the equal-rate example. The frozen numerical verifier was inspected, not used as the universal proof.
residual_risks: A covariance crossing alone is not claimed to imply a PSD peak; the crossing can also occur outside c<h. No assertion for singular noise covariance, hidden modes, or nonstationarity.

value.rationale: The useful exact result is a falsifiable boundary for when an apparent resonance can be produced by an overdamped feedforward system. It tells which anticorrelations cannot work at any positive gain, and identifies a time-domain signature consisting of one negative tail rather than repeated oscillations. This is a natural restricted null model and a sharp inferential countermechanism, not just a computed extremum at one parameter point.
residual_risks: No mechanism is identifiable from a peak alone; the model-specific boundary cannot be applied to arbitrary experimental systems.
